results.content:
Pope John Paul II[b] (born Karol Józef Wojtyła;[c] 18 May 1920 – 2 April 2005) was the head of the Catholic Church and sovereign of Vatican City from 16 October 1978 until his death in 2005.
Wojtyła became the 264th pope according to the chronological list of popes, and the first non-Italian in 455 years.
